name: DungeonCrawler
description: DungeonCrawler is a roguelike game created with the Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Graphics in C#. The goal of this project is to learn how to use C#.

name: CineTour
description: CineTour is a website that allows you to search for the locations where movies were filmed and see the points of interest around to prepare a trip.

name: SudokuSolver
description: SudokuSolver is a Sudoku solver created with Java. It uses the backtracking algorithm and WFC algorithm to solve the Sudoku. It also has a graphical and terminal interface. You can save and load Sudoku from a file.

name: TP_OS_IIS
description: TP_OS_IIS is a project that aims to create a website with IIS and PHP to manage users of the OU on a Windows VM. This project was carried out as part of the UE OS.

name: 8T
description: 8T is a board game that reinvents the traditional tic-tac-toe by introducing new rules, transforming the gaming experience with SDL2. This project was carried out as part of the UE LIFAPCD.

name: Connect4IA
description: Connect4IA is a Connect 4 game with a MinMax, AlphaBeta, and MTCS AI with a graphical interface in Python and an implementation on a NED robotic arm.

name: OnePieceWiki
description: OnePieceWiki is a website that allows you to search for information about the One Piece universe.

name: FlashCardApp
description: FlashCardApp is a web application that allows you to create flashcards to learn vocabulary words. This project aims to teach the basics of Java.

name: JavaChess
description: JavaChess is a simple chess application in Java. This project aims to teach the basics of Java.

name: Dino-Runner
description: A runner-type game created with the SDL2 library and inspired by the famous Google Dino game with a new inverted game mode.

name: Chess Game with Random AI
description: A simple chess game against an AI created with the SDL2 library.

name: Tetris
description: A simple Tetris game created with the SDL2 library.

name: Simple Calculator
description: This is a basic calculator project created using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The goal of this project is to provide hands-on experience to learn and practice JavaScript.
